summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its notice of annual and special meeting of shareholders and management information circular for the meeting to be held on May 13, 2026. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting notification with standard agenda items: receiving audited financials, electing directors, appointing auditors, approving equity incentive plan renewals, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. This is a customary annual meeting disclosure, not a special-situation event.
